objects.name: idx_decisions_agent
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_decisions_agent ON decisions(agent_id, ts)

objects.name: idx_decisions_ts
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_decisions_ts ON decisions(ts)

objects.name: idx_fills_account
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_fills_account ON fills(account_id, ts)

objects.name: idx_fills_order
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_fills_order ON fills(order_id)

objects.name: idx_ledger_account
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_ledger_account ON ledger_events(account_id, ts)

objects.name: idx_orders_account
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_account ON orders(account_id, created_at)

objects.name: idx_orders_open
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_open ON orders(status, symbol)

objects.name: idx_positions_market
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_positions_market ON positions(status, symbol)

objects.name: idx_positions_one_way
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_positions_one_way ON positions(account_id, symbol) WHERE status = 'OPEN'

objects.name: accounts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE accounts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('REPLAY','LIVE')),
  is_demo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  initial_balance TEXT NOT NULL,
  wallet_balance TEXT NOT NULL,
  used_margin TEXT NOT NULL,
  realized_pnl TEXT NOT NULL,
  fees_paid TEXT NOT NULL,
  funding_paid TEXT NOT NULL,
  config TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
, venue TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PAPER', exchange_uid TEXT, live_limits TEXT)

objects.name: agents
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agents (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES providers(id),
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
  timeframe TEXT NOT NULL,
  strategy TEXT NOT NULL,
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
  risk TEXT NOT NULL,
  interval_sec INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  running INTEGER NOT NULL,
  next_run_at INTEGER,
  last_run_at INTEGER,
  status_detail TEXT,
  consecutive_errors INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_demo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
, execution_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AUTO', use_news INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, allow_trailing_stop INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

objects.name: decisions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE decisions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: equity_history
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE equity_history (
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
  ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
  equity TEXT NOT NULL,
  wallet TEXT NOT NULL,
  unrealized TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (account_id, ts)
)

objects.name: fills
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE fills (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
  symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
  side TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity TEXT NOT NULL,
  price TEXT NOT NULL,
  fee TEXT NOT NULL,
  realized_pnl TEXT NOT NULL,
  liquidity TEXT NOT NULL,
  ts INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: instruments
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE instruments (
  symbol TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  spec TEXT NOT NULL,
  added_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: ledger_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ledger_events (
  seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount TEXT NOT NULL,
  margin_delta TEXT NOT NULL,
  wallet_after TEXT NOT NULL,
  symbol TEXT,
  order_id TEXT,
  fill_id TEXT,
  position_id TEXT,
  memo TEXT NOT NULL,
  ts INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: orders
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
  client_order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
  side TEXT NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity TEXT NOT NULL,
  price TEXT,
  trigger_price TEXT,
  leverage INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reduce_only INTEGER NOT NULL,
  close_position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  filled_quantity TEXT NOT NULL,
  avg_fill_price TEXT,
  reserved_margin TEXT NOT NULL,
  attached_stop_loss TEXT,
  attached_take_profit TEXT,
  reject_reason TEXT,
  agent_id TEXT,
  decision_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, exchange_order_id TEXT, trailing_kind TEXT, trailing_callback TEXT, trailing_activation_price TEXT, trailing_extreme TEXT, attached_trailing_stop TEXT,
  UNIQUE (account_id, client_order_id)
)

objects.name: positions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE positions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
  symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
  side TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity TEXT NOT NULL,
  entry_price TEXT NOT NULL,
  leverage INTEGER NOT NULL,
  margin TEXT NOT NULL,
  liquidation_price TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  realized_pnl TEXT NOT NULL,
  fees_paid TEXT NOT NULL,
  funding_paid TEXT NOT NULL,
  max_quantity TEXT NOT NULL,
  exit_price TEXT,
  last_funding_time INTEGER NOT NULL,
  opened_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  closed_at INTEGER
)

objects.name: provider_keys
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE provider_keys (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES providers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  api_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: providers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE providers (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  base_url TEXT,
  default_model TEXT NOT NULL,
  input_price REAL,
  output_price REAL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
, extra_headers TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

objects.name: schema_migrations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: sealed_exchange_credentials
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sealed_exchange_credentials (
  account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sealed TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: sealed_provider_keys
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sealed_provider_keys (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES providers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sealed TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: settings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE settings (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: vault_keys
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE vault_keys (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  params TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)
